info.title: Sophon Node
info.description: Sophon Node — cross-platform desktop automation agent. Connects any Windows, macOS, or Linux machine to a Sophon Gateway via SignalR and executes screen, mouse, keyboard, clipboard, and shell commands on behalf of the AI agent. Pair, start, and manage via the 'sophon-node' command.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Sophon Node — remote agent for Sophon Gateway

options.description: Pairing secret provided by the gateway
